name: arithmetic_and_polynomial_obfuscation
description: Replaced the "product is exactly 2" edge rule with a modulo arithmetic condition ((u%v) + (v%u) == 1) that evaluates to the same truth table for domain {1,2} but avoids simple equality or product checks. Replaced the "lexicographically smallest" tie-breaker with mathematical equivalence: minimizing the sequence evaluated as a base-3 polynomial sum. This prevents models from pattern-matching the standard bipartite coloring and greedy lexicographical BFS algorithms.
